test_cases.title: Valid Login with Correct OTP
test_cases.description: Verify that the user is able to log in with a valid email, password, and correct OTP
test_cases.prerequisites: User has a verified mobile number and SMS gateway is operational
test_steps: Navigate to the Login page
Enter 'john.doe@company.com' in the 'Email' field
Enter 'password123' in the 'Password' field
Click the 'Sign In' button
Verify the MFA screen appears
Enter the 6-digit OTP sent to the registered mobile number
Click the 'Submit' button
Verify the user is logged in and redirected to the dashboard
test_cases.expected_result: The user is logged in and redirected to the dashboard

test_cases.title: Login with Expired OTP
test_cases.description: Verify that the user is unable to log in with an expired OTP
test_cases.prerequisites: User has a verified mobile number and SMS gateway is operational
test_steps: Navigate to the Login page
Enter 'john.doe@company.com' in the 'Email' field
Enter 'password123' in the 'Password' field
Click the 'Sign In' button
Verify the MFA screen appears
Wait for 5 minutes to expire the OTP
Enter the expired 6-digit OTP sent to the registered mobile number
Click the 'Submit' button
Verify an error message displays: 'OTP has expired'
test_cases.expected_result: An error message displays: 'OTP has expired'

test_cases.title: Account Lockout after 3 Failed Attempts
test_cases.description: Verify that the user account is locked out after 3 failed OTP attempts
test_cases.prerequisites: User has a verified mobile number and SMS gateway is operational
test_steps: Navigate to the Login page
Enter 'john.doe@company.com' in the 'Email' field
Enter 'password123' in the 'Password' field
Click the 'Sign In' button
Verify the MFA screen appears
Enter an incorrect 6-digit OTP sent to the registered mobile number
Click the 'Submit' button
Verify an error message displays: 'Invalid OTP'
Repeat steps 6-8 two more times
Verify the account is locked out and an error message displays: 'Account locked out for 30 minutes'
test_cases.expected_result: The account is locked out and an error message displays: 'Account locked out for 30 minutes'

test_cases.title: Export Dashboard Data as CSV
test_cases.description: Verify that the user is able to export dashboard analytics data in CSV format
test_cases.prerequisites: User has export permissions and is logged in to the Dashboard page
test_steps: Navigate to the Dashboard page
Verify the Export button is visible on the dashboard page
Click the Export button
Verify the export options dropdown appears
Select CSV from the export options dropdown
Select a custom date range for data filtering
Click the Export button to download the CSV file
Verify the CSV file downloads within 30 seconds
Verify the CSV file contains the same data displayed on the dashboard
test_cases.expected_result: The user is able to export dashboard analytics data in CSV format and the file contains the same data displayed on the dashboard

test_cases.title: Admin Full Access
test_cases.description: Verify that the Admin user is able to view, edit, and delete all resources
test_cases.prerequisites: Admin user role assigned, resources exist in the system
test_steps: Navigate to the Login page
Enter 'admin@example.com' in the 'Email' field
Enter 'password123' in the 'Password' field
Click the 'Sign In' button
Navigate to the Resource Management page
Verify the 'View' button is visible for a resource
Verify the 'Edit' button is visible for a resource
Verify the 'Delete' button is visible for a resource
Click the 'Edit' button for a resource
Make changes to the resource and click 'Save'
Verify the changes are reflected on the Resource Management page
Click the 'Delete' button for a resource
Verify the resource is removed from the Resource Management page
test_cases.expected_result: The Admin user can view, edit, and delete resources without any restrictions

test_cases.title: Manager Restricted Delete
test_cases.description: Verify that the Manager user can view and edit but cannot delete resources
test_cases.prerequisites: Manager user role assigned, resources exist in the system
test_steps: Navigate to the Login page
Enter 'manager@example.com' in the 'Email' field
Enter 'password123' in the 'Password' field
Click the 'Sign In' button
Navigate to the Resource Management page
Verify the 'View' button is visible for a resource
Verify the 'Edit' button is visible for a resource
Verify the 'Delete' button is not visible for a resource
Click the 'Edit' button for a resource
Make changes to the resource and click 'Save'
Verify the changes are reflected on the Resource Management page
Attempt to delete a resource and verify the 'Access Denied' message is displayed
test_cases.expected_result: The Manager user can view and edit resources but cannot delete them

test_cases.title: Viewer Read-Only
test_cases.description: Verify that the Viewer user can only view resources
test_cases.prerequisites: Viewer user role assigned, resources exist in the system
test_steps: Navigate to the Login page
Enter 'viewer@example.com' in the 'Email' field
Enter 'password123' in the 'Password' field
Click the 'Sign In' button
Navigate to the Resource Management page
Verify the 'View' button is visible for a resource
Verify the 'Edit' button is not visible for a resource
Verify the 'Delete' button is not visible for a resource
Attempt to edit a resource and verify the 'Access Denied' message is displayed
Attempt to delete a resource and verify the 'Access Denied' message is displayed
test_cases.expected_result: The Viewer user can only view resources and cannot edit or delete them

test_cases.title: Unauthorized Action
test_cases.description: Verify that unauthorized actions display the 'Access Denied' message
test_cases.prerequisites: Admin, Manager, and Viewer user roles assigned, resources exist in the system
test_steps: Navigate to the Login page
Enter 'admin@example.com' in the 'Email' field
Enter 'password123' in the 'Password' field
Click the 'Sign In' button
Navigate to the Resource Management page
Attempt to perform an action that is not allowed for the Admin role (e.g. create a new resource without permission)
Verify the 'Access Denied' message is displayed
Logout and login as Manager
Attempt to perform an action that is not allowed for the Manager role (e.g. delete a resource)
Verify the 'Access Denied' message is displayed
Logout and login as Viewer
Attempt to perform an action that is not allowed for the Viewer role (e.g. edit a resource)
Verify the 'Access Denied' message is displayed
test_cases.expected_result: Unauthorized actions display the 'Access Denied' message
test_cases.test_data: admin@example.com, password123, manager@example.com, password123, viewer@example.com, password123
